products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company offers a range of products spanning clinical decision support, imaging, clinical trial data management, and health data analytics. Its clinical decision support tool, Micromedex, is positioned for point-of-care use by clinicians, while Zelta is a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed to support clinical trials programs. The company's imaging portfolio includes Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo described as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked products. Truven is offered as a health data and analytics service providing what the company calls gold standard health data alongside consulting services, and a separate real-world evidence portfolio is also available.

The company's held facts note that Merative was formerly known as Watson Health, situating it within the healthcare and life sciences AI category with a focus on healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. Customer-reported outcomes cited on the company's site include an auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid rising from 17% to 80%, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort, as well as a projection that identifying fetal toxicities could be reduced from a ten-year process to fewer than five years using the company's data capabilities.
